# Results — Study 794 (Commodity Carry)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
**backwardated commodities (positive roll yield / carry) out-earn contangoed ones,
cross-sectionally** (Gorton-Rouwenhorst 2006; Erb-Harvey 2006; Koijen et al. 2018),
tested as an honest **two-name energy proxy**: carry read from the real EIA futures
term structure (WTI, Henry Hub gas), returns from the investable front-month ETFs.
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last complete calendar month; the partial current
month is dropped). Fingerprints: EIA curve `ce2aaac1d6db`, energy ETFs `8de803f53090`.*

> **Proxy caveat, stated up front.** Two names is the thinnest cross-section possible —
> every cross-sectional number below is under-powered by construction and can neither
> confirm nor refute the broad-universe factor in the literature.

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Carry signal | EIA v2 daily near-month energy futures — WTI `RCLC1/RCLC2` ($/bbl), Henry Hub gas `RNGC1/RNGC2` ($/MMBtu); 4,856 rows, 2005-01-03 → **2024-04-05** (the free EIA near-month futures series were **discontinued 2024-04**). Fingerprint `ce2aaac1d6db` |
| Investable returns | yfinance total-return closes for USO / USL (WTI front / 12-mo ladder) and UNG / UNL (gas front / ladder); 5,087 rows, 2006-04-10 → 2026-06-30. Fingerprint `8de803f53090` |
| Carry construction | monthly annualized log roll yield `ln(C1/C2)·12` off the last settle of each calendar month (point-in-time, no look-ahead); `C1 > C2` (backwardation) → positive carry |
| Panel | **422** (commodity, month) rows across **217** months, two commodities (WTI, gas), 2006-04 → 2024-04; the workhorse uses the **205** months where both names are present |
| Execution / lag | carry known at month-end `t`; the front-month ETF return is realized over `t+1` (one documented execution lag, zero look-ahead) |
| Statistics | **Newey-West (6-lag)** HAC *t* on the pooled cross-sectionally-demeaned carry→return regression (the workhorse) and on the timer's monthly series; Welch *t* on the backwardation/contango split; Wilson interval on the hit rate; a 20-seed synthetic positive control |

The EIA free near-month futures series were discontinued in April 2024, so the joint
panel ends 2024-04; the ETF tapes run to 2026-06 but have no curve to sort against
after that date.

## The workhorse — pooled cross-sectional carry → forward return (NW 6-lag)

Cross-sectionally demean **both** carry and the forward front-ETF return within each
month (removing the common energy move), then Newey-West-regress demeaned return on
demeaned carry. The slope is the pure cross-sectional carry premium per unit of
annualized roll yield; the NW *t* is the decisive real-tape number.

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observations | **410** over **205** two-name months |
| slope (return per unit annualized carry) | **−0.0145** |
| correlation (demeaned) | −0.055 |
| **Newey-West (6-lag) *t*** | **−0.95** |

The slope is small, **wrong-signed**, and nowhere near the desk's *t* ≥ 2 bar. On two
names the cross-sectional average can't out-shout the idiosyncratic energy noise — this
is a statement about the proxy's power, not a refutation of the broad-universe factor.

## Conditional split — forward front-ETF return, backwardation vs contango (pooled)

| condition | n | mean forward return |
|---|--:|--:|
| backwardated (carry > 0) | 105 | **−1.01%/mo** |
| contangoed (carry < 0) | 316 | −1.20%/mo |
| Welch *t* (back − cont) | | **+0.13** |
| backwardated hit rate (forward return > 0) | 46/105 | **43.8%** (Wilson 95% [34.7%, 53.4%]) |

Directionally the backwardated months earn *slightly* more, but the gap is statistically
nothing (Welch *t* = +0.13) and the backwardated hit rate sits **below** a coin flip.
Inconclusive on this slice.

## Roll mechanism — USO minus USL vs WTI carry (NW 6-lag)

The front-minus-laddered gap on the *same* crude is the realized roll: in backwardation
the front fund (USO) should out-roll its 12-month ladder (USL). This is independent of
the cross-sectional sort.

| quantity | value |
|---|--:|
| observations | 197 |
| slope | **+0.0409** |
| **Newey-West (6-lag) *t*** | **+2.23** |
| sign-agreement | 49% |
| mean USO−USL gap, backwardation | −0.33%/mo |
| mean USO−USL gap, contango | −0.76%/mo |

**The roll mechanism is real and clears the bar on the investable tape** (NW *t* = +2.23):
backwardation genuinely makes the front fund out-roll its ladder (the gap is less
negative when the curve is backwardated). The mechanism was never the weak link.

## The timer — two-name cross-sectional long-short, monthly, costed + borrow

Long the more-backwardated ETF, short the more-contangoed one each month, equal dollar
notional; one-way bps × turnover × NAV per leg, the short leg pays 100 bps/yr borrow.

| cost (one-way) | gross | net | net NW *t* | net Sharpe | worst month |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 5 bps + 100 bps/yr borrow | **−9.46%/yr** (NW *t* = −1.48, Sharpe −0.35) | **−12.86%/yr** | **−2.01** | −0.48 | −31.27% |
| 10 bps + 100 bps/yr borrow | −9.46%/yr | **−15.26%/yr** | **−2.38** | −0.56 | −31.47% |

The book loses money **gross** (−9.46%/yr) — a thin, wrong-signed sort dominated by two
crash-prone energy legs — and costs plus short borrow only deepen the loss (net
−12.86%/yr, NW *t* = −2.01 at 5 bps). A single worst month is ≈ −31%. **Not investable.**

## Synthetic positive control — the machinery is unbiased

Deterministic seeded two-commodity panel with a TUNABLE planted cross-sectional carry
premium; no network. The null (premium = 0) is checked over **20 seeds**.

| world | NW(6) *t* |
|---|--:|
| null (premium = 0), **20 seeds** | mean **+0.30** (sd 1.03), **\|t\| ≥ 2 in 1/20 seeds** |
| planted premium = 0.15 (seed 794) | slope +0.1453, *t* = **+7.80** |

The detector essentially never fires on the null (1/20 ≈ the nominal 5% false-positive
rate) and lights up strongly on a planted premium (*t* = +7.80). So the real-tape *t*
below 2 is a genuine **power limit of two names**, not a broken estimator. *(A
faithful-engine / power check only — never cited in support of a real-tape stamp.)*

## Verdict

- **Signal — WEAK.** Pooled cross-sectional carry→forward-return NW(6) *t* = **−0.95**
  (slope −0.0145, corr −0.055) over 205 two-name months — not significant and, if
  anything, wrong-signed; backwardated −1.01%/mo vs contango −1.20%/mo (Welch *t* =
  +0.13), backwardated hit rate 43.8% (below a coin flip). The roll **mechanism** is
  real (USO-USL vs carry NW *t* = +2.23), but the cross-sectional **premium** is not
  established on a two-name proxy.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The long-short loses money gross (−9.46%/yr, NW *t* = −1.48)
  and net (−12.86%/yr, NW *t* = −2.01, Sharpe −0.48, worst month −31.3% at 5 bps;
  −15.26%/yr at 10 bps). Two crash-prone energy legs are not a harvestable premium.
- **Roll mechanism? — CONFIRMED.** On the investable tape the USO-minus-USL front-vs-
  ladder gap regresses positive on WTI carry (NW *t* = +2.23, less-negative gap in
  backwardation). Backwardation genuinely makes the front fund out-roll its ladder —
  the mechanism is real even though a certifiable, tradable cross-sectional premium on
  two names is not.
